sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of the Marshall Islands: current consular visa information
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Washington, D.C.
sources.officialityEvidence: The live RMI Embassy consular page states the current ordinary-visitor A/B/C partition: named exemptions, diplomatic-relations visa on arrival, and a prior-visa residual.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens from ALL OTHER countries not listed in A or B above must apply for visa PRIOR TO traveling to the Republic.

unresolved.reason: The current RMI rule makes arrival issuance depend on diplomatic relations. No current official RMI or Nigerien record directly proves relations or proves they have not been established; no result is inferred from omissions or historical lists.
